about: Every string the guided screens show. Plain words in text; a CM1 name only in hint, drawn small and grey after the words. {name} fields are filled with the run's own numbers.

gallery.data.text: Each one is a CM1 case that GM1 runs. Pick one, then pick how long it may run.

gallery.about_nogpu.text: About {wall} on an RTX 3080 (no GPU found here)

gallery.empty.text: No presets are installed. Reinstall gpuwm-cm1.

gallery.why_offered.text: Only storms GM1 runs are offered. A card says so when one of its settings has not yet been compared with CM1. A greyed card says why it is not offered here.

gallery.not_compared.text: Runs, not yet compared with CM1:

gallery.needs_budget.text: Too long for {own} on your GPU, so it opens on {budget}.

gallery.own_namelist.text: Have your own CM1 namelist? Switch to Advanced at the top.

gallery.no_gpu.text: No NVIDIA GPU answered on this computer, so no storm can run here.

budget.own_data.text: Your sounding: {name}. An idealized storm in the air of your own sounding.

budget.own_caption.text: Your sounding: its temperature, moisture and wind, as the model will read them.

budget.file_air.text: The air is the sounding file this storm runs on. To try other air, go back to the gallery and choose another sounding.

budget.own_note.text: Your sounding is the air everywhere in the area: flat ground, the same air on every side. The view follows the storm this air makes, and the changes listed say how fast it moves and where the storm starts. It is not a forecast, and not a reconstruction of any real day's storms.

gallery.no_gpu_fix.text: Open System, on the left, or run gpuwm-cm1 doctor --plain in a terminal; it says what is missing and how to fix it.

gallery.old_driver.text: Your NVIDIA driver is version {driver}; GM1 needs version {minimum} or newer.

gallery.old_driver_fix.text: Update the NVIDIA driver, then open this page again.

gallery.group.start_line.text: Quick storms to try first: CM1's own supercell case, from a quick look to fine detail.

gallery.group.famous_line.text: The air measured by weather balloons on well-known days, each put into an idealized storm.

gallery.group.explore_line.text: Change the air and see which kind of storm it makes.

gallery.group.other_line.text: A hurricane, lines of storms, a gust front, and a single growing cloud.

gallery.famous_note.text: This day's sounding in an idealized storm, not a reconstruction of that day's storms.

budget.levels_stretched.text: {count} levels, {bottom} at the bottom to {top} aloft

budget.nothing_else.text: Nothing else: your choices fit as they are.

budget.badge.host.text: Too big for this computer's memory

budget.not_offered.text: Not offered for this time on this computer

budget.estimated.text: Times and sizes are estimated from speeds GM1 measured on real runs; your GPU's own speed is used once it has run.

budget.air_made.text: {sentence} CAPE {cape} J/kg and {shear} m/s of wind shear over 6 km, on the model's own levels.

custom.intro.text: Change what you like. GM1 keeps what you set and fits the rest to your GPU and time.

custom.advanced_note.text: Makes the run folder with these choices and opens every CM1 setting. Nothing runs until you press Start there.

custom.live.text: About {wall} on your {gpu} · {memory} of GPU memory · {disk} of disk (estimated)

custom.live_nogpu.text: About {wall} on an RTX 3080 (no GPU found here) · {memory} of GPU memory · {disk} of disk (estimated)

custom.live_not.text: Not offered with these choices for this time.

custom.live_see.text: See why and what to change

custom.checking_inside.text: Checking what would keep the storm inside the area...

custom.need_longer.text: With {budget} GM1 fits a {area} area: about {wall} on your {gpu}.

custom.need_longer_nogpu.text: With {budget} GM1 fits a {area} area: about {wall} on an RTX 3080.

custom.edge_area.text: The smallest area here without this note is {value}.

custom.inside_area.text: It stays inside with an area {value} wide.

custom.inside_none.text: Even the largest area this storm offers ({value}) does not keep it inside.

custom.inside_undo_one.text: Or undo the one change that moves it out:

custom.inside_undo.text: Or undo one of these changes; any one of them keeps it inside:

custom.caption.text: The picture shows the preset as it ships. You changed: {what}.

custom.caption_storm.text: Your changes to the air or the push make a different storm, so yours will look different.

custom.levels_any.text: Any height from {low} up: the model takes at most {count} levels. The top moves by less than half a level when the height does not divide it.

custom.levels_box.text: Height of a level in metres

custom.grid_any.text: Any spacing: press one, slide, or type it. The area keeps its size, rounded up to whole cells, the time step follows, and GM1 fits the area to your card.

custom.grid_bad.text: Type a spacing in metres, above 0.

custom.levels_bad.text: Type a height in metres, above 0.

custom.levels_over.text: That would be {count} levels, and the model takes at most {most}.

custom.levels_under.text: That would be {count} levels, and the model needs at least {fewest}.

custom.grid_finest.text: The finest grid this card has room for with this storm is about {value}, on its smallest area ({area}).

custom.follow_storm.text: Keep this area and follow the storm

custom.area_cut_run.text: Made {value} wide (you chose {was}): the largest area one saved picture holds with this grid and these levels.

custom.area_cut_offer.text: Made {value} wide (you chose {was}): the largest this storm offers.

custom.area_raised.text: Made {value} wide (you chose {was}): the smallest this grid allows.

custom.rotation_note.text: Nothing balances it, so the wind slowly turns as the hours pass, about 20 degrees in 2 hours, as it does in CM1.

custom.rotation_note_short.text: Over a storm this short it turns the wind very little.

custom.parcels_note.text: Needs an area at least 120 km across: CM1's own parcel grid covers 120 km.

custom.bumps_note.text: On uses CM1's own random numbers. Another draw uses GM1's, so the details differ from CM1's.

custom.air_note.text: The two sliders of Make your own environment.

custom.air_own.text: The preset's own air until you move a slider.

custom.sea_note.text: CM1's hurricane case has 28 °C. Warmer water feeds a stronger storm and cooler water a weaker one. Only 28 °C has been run, in GM1 and in CM1.

custom.friction_note.text: It runs. CM1's supercell with ground friction was compared with CM1 on an RTX 4090: nine statistics are 0.986 to 1.018 of CM1's and the strongest spin is 1.072 of CM1's (measured). It has not been compared with CM1 in any other storm or on any other card.

custom.caption_storm_sea.text: A different sea temperature makes a different storm, so yours will look different.

watch.stopping.text: Stopping at the next step. The pictures so far are kept.

watch.first_picture.text: The first picture appears once the storm's first saved time is drawn.

watch.starting.text: Starting: GM1 is preparing your GPU. This takes 10 to 60 seconds.

watch.waiting_gpu.text: Waiting for the GPU: another run is using it. This one starts when it ends.

watch.finished_drawing.text: Finished. The last pictures are still being drawn; they appear here in about {wall}.

watch.drawing.text: Drawing the pictures on the processor: {drawn} of {saved} done (about {wall} more).

watch.behind.text: The pictures are drawn on the processor after the GPU saves each time, and they are running behind ({drawn} of {saved} drawn); they catch up when the run ends.

watch.stop_confirm.text: Stop ends this storm now. GM1 saves the point a storm is continued from when the storm reaches its end, so a storm stopped before then cannot be run longer later. The pictures so far are kept. Stop it?

watch.stopped.text: Stopped. The pictures up to now are kept.

watch.failed.text: The run stopped with an error. Advanced (at the top) shows its log.

watch.not_started.text: This run has not started yet, so there is nothing to watch. Its Ready to start page starts it.

watch.first_picture_start.text: First picture at {clock}, the air at the start, as soon as the GPU has started. Then one every {interval} of storm time.

watch.first_picture_at.text: First picture at {clock} of storm time.

watch.first_picture_in.text: First picture at {clock} of storm time, in about {wall}.

watch.next_picture_drawing.text: The picture for {clock} is being drawn now.

watch.first_picture_drawing.text: The first picture, for {clock}, is being drawn now.

storm.none_usual.text: No storm yet: in this setup the storm usually appears between {from} and {to} of storm time.

storm.none.text: No storm yet: it has not formed at this time.

storm.forming.text: The storm is starting to form higher up. The reflectivity picture at 1 km shows it once its rain falls that far.

storm.none_ended.text: No storm formed in this run: this air did not make one in the storm time it ran.

storm.none_own_bubble.text: This run on your own sounding started from a warm bubble, which often makes no storm on real soundings even when the air has the energy for one. Try the push of rising air: choose your sounding again on the gallery's Use my own sounding card and pick that start.

storm.none_stopped.text: No storm yet: the run ended at {clock}, before this storm usually appears ({from} to {to}).

storm.hurricane.none.text: The starting swirl has no rain yet. Rain cells usually appear around it by about hour 6.

storm.hurricane.ragged.text: Rain cells are forming around the swirl. It looks ragged at first, then tightens: in GM1's own run of this storm the eye is clear by {eye}.

storm.hurricane.none_ended.text: No rain had formed around the swirl when this run ended.

results.no_pictures.text: No pictures yet. They are drawn as each saved time is written; this page updates by itself.

results.trimmed.text: The big files of this storm were deleted to free disk space. Its pictures are kept.

results.run_longer_trimmed.text: Not offered: the big files of this storm were deleted, so there is no saved point to go on from.

results.files_where.text: The output is in CM1's netCDF format, one file per saved time, in {folder}. Copy one of these lines:

results.files_where_other.text: The output is in CM1's own file formats, as its settings ask, in {folder}. Copy one of these lines:

results.no_files.text: The files appear here as the run writes them.

results.no_frames.text: This run ended before its first saved time, so it has no pictures to show, film or slice, and no files to open.

results.not_started.text: This run has not started yet, so it has no pictures or files. Its Ready to start page starts it.

results.no_files_not_started.text: No files: this run has not started yet.

results.run_longer_started.text: Running on from where it stopped.

results.run_longer_none.text: This run stopped before its end, so it has no saved point to go on from. Start the storm again for a longer run.

results.show_everything_about.text: Advanced shows the namelist, the check against CM1, the estimate and every setting.
